title: Flip the sync modules that have no sync reason; inject the executor's query step

epic.name: Async test suite through dependency injection

story.i_want_to: the sync modules that state no real need for it to run async
story.so_that: their time leaves the sync phase

rationale: Their stated reason (Repo.with_tenant needs shared sandbox mode) is false: each seeds and reads on Repo in the test process. Run together async three times, all passed except ContextRetriever.ExecutorTest TC-30.3.6, which drops a column on stories to provoke :undefined_column and so holds a DDL lock (Loopctl.Test.LockGuard refuses it).

acceptance_criteria.description: Every converted module is `async: true`; the commit gate passes; production behaviour is unchanged (the injected input defaults to the value the code read before).
Executor.run/4 takes an injectable query step defaulting to the Repo read; TC-30.3.6 supplies one that raises Postgrex :undefined_column and asserts :stale_entity, with no DDL.

test_cases.name: Flipped modules pass async
steps: Run the listed files together three times with different seeds
expected_results: 0 failures each run; no LockGuard refusal
